request_work_unit: request a new work unit from the orchestrator server for a given robot job ID
get_current_work_unit: get the current work unit assigned to the robot and return its details
complete_work_unit: complete a work unit with an outcome, success score, session times, and question responses
start_work_unit_execution: start work unit execution after scene preparation is complete for the robot
observe_latest_work_unit: observe the latest work unit for a given job type like EVALUATION or COLLECTION
